race.comment: The G1 Victoria Derby, in all of its 2500m glory. Barriers can be key from this start and have us siding with CORMIER (1) who backs up from the G1 Spring Champion at Randwick last week. He was allowed to roll along there and stayed on strongly for third behind two top fillies; he should stay this well and prove very hard to catch. STORMY MARCO (2) has had things against his past two, very good from back in the field in the Spring Champion last week. Gets J-Mac on now to help offset the tricky gate and will be charging home. CIGNETTI (8) might be the best value for exotics. He just had to wait for a run in the G3 Caulfield Classic and would've won in another stride. He can roll forward and run well. SKUA (7) looks an out-and-out stayer. He was beaten at the 300m last week and just kept finding behind TRUE REBEL. Fancy he can turn the tables up in trip. KING SNITZ (4) won the Caulfield Classic and should stay as well.
